authority_reconciliation: All new entries in v5 are limited to canonical synthetic-only scope. V3-V7 real historical economics records remain preserved as HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_PRODUCED_UNDER_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT and are not retroactively authorized.

hypothesis: PL-style ordered-top3 mapping may become structurally misspecified in synthetic worlds with conditional line relations/disruption/heavy tails, and a fixed PRE-only N1 conditional chain may reduce that failure mode.
input_dataset: Source-independent Digital Twin W0-W4 only; seed 20260913; 240 standard 7-rider synthetic races per world; 1200 synthetic races total; no real/historical race inputs.
prediction_method: Preregistered fixed C0_SCORE_PL, C1_LINE_PL, and N1_CONDITIONAL architectures using PRE-only synthetic observables. No post-outcome tuning, world deletion, odds, economics, RESULT/PAYOUT, or real evidence.
conclusion: NO_STABLE_SYNTHETIC_ARCHITECTURE_ADVANTAGE. The best PL mapping degraded by about 28.2% in aggregate KL from W0-W1 to W2-W4, but the preregistered N1 conditional architecture did not rescue that hard-world aggregate; its W2-W4 mean KL was about 4.7% worse than best-PL. N1 was lowest-KL only in the explicitly conditional W2 world, while C0_SCORE_PL was lowest in W0, W1, W3 and W4. This falsifies a simple universal N1 rescue under the tested synthetic worlds; it does not establish any real-keirin calibration or predictive claim.
follow_up: Remain synthetic-only. A successor may preregister a PRE-only uncertainty/regime-adaptive mixture or abstention hypothesis on separate synthetic design/evaluation seeds, but must not use world identity or real RESULT/PAYOUT/economics evidence, and cannot promote a real model or claim ROI/profitability.
